method: Reviewed the official City Legistar matter record and every official attachment. Downloaded and extracted each original, compared SHA-256 values, and rendered all pages of the signed enactment because its text layer is empty.

matter.title: Adopting the Menaul Redevelopment Study and Recommendations as City Policy

attachments.title: R-21-207 original resolution
attachments.reason: The two-page original is the unenacted proposal; the signed R-2021-079 enactment is the authoritative final City policy record.

attachments.title: R-21-207 Menaul Redevelopment Study draft
attachments.reason: Exact SHA-256 match to the already retained Menaul Redevelopment Study. This attachment is the study itself, not a distinct legislative wrapper.

attachments.title: R-21-207 enacted resolution
attachments.reason: Visually verified signed R-2021-079, adopted November 3 and approved November 12, 2021. It separately establishes the study as current City policy and identifies implementation funding; it is not a wrapper around the study.

result: The enacted resolution is a distinct official action and should be retained beside the already archived study. The original proposal is superseded, and the attached study is an exact duplicate of the existing archive.
